svg.title: stdx's brotli against its baselines, on AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor
svg.desc: brotli decoding, in multiples of Google's speed: ahead on 39, level on 0, behind on 0 of 39 files; 1.03 to 3.35. brotli encoding: speed in multiples of Google's quality 5, against compression ratio: no other library's point is both faster and smaller than any of stdx's 2 levels.
svg.text: stdx's brotli against its baselines, on AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor
One job of run 45895089065 at commit fdfbb70. The line at 1 is the baseline each panel's title names; the axis is logarithmic.
brotli decoding, in multiples of Google's speed
ahead on 39, level on 0, behind on 0 of 39 files; 1.03 to 3.35
brotli encoding: speed in multiples of Google's quality 5, against compression ratio
no other library's point is both faster and smaller than any of stdx's 2 levels
The number beside a point is its level. Up is smaller output, and right is faster.
† the benchmark repeats this file of 256 KiB or less, so the branch predictor learns it (decision 45)
▲ marks a row 5% or more faster than at v0.3.0, past the noise of both, ▼ one that much slower, and a dashed line its value at v0.3.0.
